page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 256 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, but it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core capabilities, with the instance scoring in the top 25% for multi-core CPU performance, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and software compilation. Cryptographic operations and database operations also demonstrate strong performance. Conversely, single-core performance, including single-threaded gzip compression and single-core stress-ng tests, falls within the average range. Memory bandwidth and Redis SET operations also perform at average levels.

The instance offers high resource density for multi-threaded applications, making it cost-efficient for workloads that can leverage all 64 dedicated cores simultaneously. However, the lack of local storage requires external block storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs. The instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads such as software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and small-scale language model inference, while being less optimal for single-threaded tasks or workloads requiring local NVMe storage.
